product_version: Amazon SES Developer Guide/API and Gmail sender guidelines, checked 2026-10-05
version_sensitive_claims: Q1: SES has account/region sending quotas and API throttling; over-quota request is not queued for automatic redelivery.
Q2: SES/SNS notifications have no ordering guarantee; delivery can precede bounce; SES suppression reasons include BOUNCE and COMPLAINT and scope can be account or tenant.
Q3: Gmail sender requirements depend on sender category and volume; SES monitors bounce and complaint rates and may pause sending.
Q4: SES tenant management separates identities and reputation metrics; dedicated IP pools can isolate streams but require warmup/cost.
staleness_risks: Gmail sender requirements and SES tenant features may change; recheck for version-sensitive edits.
Queue partitioning, quotas and suppression policy are design choices, not automatic guarantees of SES.
Author semantic MCQ review and automatic gates only; independent blind review remains TODO.
notes: Mail-specific lifecycle extends Notification System Q1–Q4 without repeating its general retry and delivery model.
